claims.claim_text: Section 3(29) defines DAE as post-baccalaureate, pre-licensure experience of two years with varied phases of architectural service.
Section 13 requires citizenship/reciprocity, good moral character, a recognized BS Architecture degree, certified two years or equivalent DAE, and no moral-turpitude conviction.
Section 13 credits a qualifying Master of Architecture degree as one year toward practical experience.

Section 13 lists application documents including NSO birth certificate, diploma, transcript, DT forms, mentor affidavit, mentor PIC/PTR/IAPOA documentation, NBI clearance, and other required documents.
Section 13 authorizes refusal, suspension, or revocation when false evidence, false information, or misrepresentation is used.
